mapper.sql: ENTERPRISE_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, CREDIT_CODE, ENTERPRISE_TYPE, SUPERVISION_LEVEL, REGION, INDUSTRY, ENTERPRISE_STATUS, REGISTERED_CAPITAL, ESTABLISH_DATE, LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE, CONTACT_PHONE, ENTERPRISE_EMAIL, ENTERPRISE_ADDRESS, BUSINESS_SCOPE, LISTING_STATUS, STOCK_CODE, RISK_LEVEL, IS_STATE_CONTROLLED, PARENT_ENTERPRISE_ID, REMARKS, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE ( ENTERPRISE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CREDIT_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY ENTERPRISE_NAME
LIMIT 50
AND ROWNUM <= 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalEnterprises, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENTERPRISE_STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) AS normalEnterprises, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENTERPRISE_STATUS = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 END) AS suspendedEnterprises, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENTERPRISE_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS cancelledEnterprises, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_STATE_CONTROLLED = 1 THEN 1 END) AS stateControlledEnterprises, COUNT(CASE WHEN LISTING_STATUS = 'LISTED' THEN 1 END) AS listedEnterprises, COUNT(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) AS highRiskEnterprises, AVG(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS avgRegisteredCapital, SUM(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS totalRegisteredCapital FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO

SELECT ENTERPRISE_TYPE AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO GROUP BY ENTERPRISE_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT REGION AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO GROUP BY REGION ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT INDUSTRY AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO GROUP BY INDUSTRY ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ENTERPRISE_STATUS AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO GROUP BY ENTERPRISE_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT SUPERVISION_LEVEL AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO GROUP BY SUPERVISION_LEVEL ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 1000000 THEN '100万以下' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 10000000 THEN '100万-1000万' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 100000000 THEN '1000万-1亿' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 1000000000 THEN '1亿-10亿' ELSE '10亿以上' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE REGISTERED_CAPITAL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 1000000 THEN '100万以下' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 10000000 THEN '100万-1000万' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 100000000 THEN '1000万-1亿' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 1000000000 THEN '1亿-10亿' ELSE '10亿以上' END ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
YEAR(ESTABLISH_DATE) AS name,
EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ESTABLISH_DATE) AS name,
COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE ESTABLISH_DATE IS NOT NULL), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE ESTABLISH_DATE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY YEAR(ESTABLISH_DATE) ORDER BY YEAR(ESTABLISH_DATE) DESC
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ESTABLISH_DATE) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ESTABLISH_DATE) DESC

SELECT LISTING_STATUS AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO GROUP BY LISTING_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT RISK_LEVEL AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO GROUP BY RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalStateControlled, COUNT(CASE WHEN LISTING_STATUS = 'LISTED' THEN 1 END) AS listedStateControlled, SUM(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS totalCapital, AVG(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS avgCapital FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE IS_STATE_CONTROLLED = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalListed, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_STATE_CONTROLLED = 1 THEN 1 END) AS stateControlledListed, SUM(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS totalCapital, AVG(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS avgCapital FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE LISTING_STATUS = 'LISTED'

SELECT CASE WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 1000000 THEN '小微企业' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 50000000 THEN '小型企业' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 200000000 THEN '中型企业' ELSE '大型企业' END AS scale, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS totalCapital, AVG(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS avgCapital, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE REGISTERED_CAPITAL IS NOT NULL), 2) AS percentage FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE REGISTERED_CAPITAL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 1000000 THEN '小微企业' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 50000000 THEN '小型企业' WHEN REGISTERED_CAPITAL < 200000000 THEN '中型企业' ELSE '大型企业' END ORDER BY avgCapital DESC

SELECT
YEAR(ESTABLISH_DATE) AS year,
EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ESTABLISH_DATE) AS year,
COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS totalCapital, AVG(REGISTERED_CAPITAL) AS avgCapital FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE ESTABLISH_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND ESTABLISH_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 YEAR) GROUP BY YEAR(ESTABLISH_DATE) ORDER BY YEAR(ESTABLISH_DATE)
AND ESTABLISH_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -120) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ESTABLISH_DATE) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ESTABLISH_DATE)

SELECT FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE ( SUPERVISION_LEVEL = 'NATIONAL' OR IS_STATE_CONTROLLED = 1 OR LISTING_STATUS = 'LISTED' OR REGISTERED_CAPITAL >= 1000000000 ) ORDER BY REGISTERED_CAPITAL DESC
LIMIT 100
AND ROWNUM <= 100
SELECT FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE ESTABLISH_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ESTABLISH_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12) ORDER BY ESTABLISH_DATE DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_ENTERPRISE_INFO WHERE REGISTERED_CAPITAL >= #{threshold} ORDER BY REGISTERED_CAPITAL DESC
